title: The Singing Vein
text: A vein of crystal runs through the rock, pale blue and glowing faintly. It rings like glass when touched, filling the tunnel with a long low hum that settles in the bones. Something deeper in the rock hums back.

options.label: Mine the singing crystal, hoping the deeper hum does not mind.

outcomes.text: The crystal holds essence. It rings in the sack as you walk.
The hum becomes a shriek. The tunnel answers.

options.label: The keenest ear listens to it to hear the shape of the tunnels ahead.

outcomes.text: The echoes trace the tunnels ahead. You know the way.

options.label: Leave it singing; some things should not be silenced.

outcomes.text: Its soothing hum follows you a while, until the deeper hum takes over.
